# `bs add`

- **Usage:** `bs add [FLAGS] [SHELF]`

Save a new bit, preserving the supplied body verbatim

## Arguments
- **`[SHELF]`**

## Flags
- **`--title <TITLE>`**
- **`--tags <TAGS>`**
- **`--slug <SLUG>`**
- **`--file <FILE>`**
- **`--stdin`**
- **`--interactive`**
